Frequently asked questions

Where can I celebrate New Year's Eve in Amsterdam beyond the big clubs?

Look for short-run pop-ups, one-off parties at independent venues, late openings and public countdown events. This page lists checked pop ups and one-off events; times and prices can change, so follow the organiser's link before you go.

Are there free New Year's Eve events in Amsterdam?

Yes. The municipality organises free public countdown events at several places in the city, and some pop-ups and neighbourhood events are free too. Others need a ticket or a reservation. Each listing states the price as given by the organiser.

Is there a public fireworks show in Amsterdam?

Yes. The municipality organises professional fireworks and light shows at several places in the city, including Museumplein, and they are free to attend. See the city's New Year celebrations page for places and times.

Do I need to book New Year's Eve popups in advance?

It depends on the event. Some pop-ups are walk-in; others ask you to reserve or buy a ticket. The listing repeats what the organiser published; use their link to book.

How do I know this list is current?

We check each event on the organiser's own page before listing it, and we drop events once their last day has passed. Recheck the organiser's link for the latest time and price.
